nights.title: Alex Sampson - The Nonstop Flight Tour
nights.name: Alex Sampson
nights.extract: Alex Darren Sampson is a Canadian singer and songwriter, best known for finishing as a semi-finalist on the 19th season of America's Got Talent. His sophomore EP Hopeless Romantic (2024) was released by Warner Music Group, and featured his single "Pretty Baby". He was featured on People magazine's "Emerging Artists" list in 2023.

nights.title: Flowerovlove
nights.name: Flowerovlove
nights.extract: Joyce Cissé, known professionally as Flowerovlove, is an English singer-songwriter, producer and model. She debuted as a teenager in 2020 and released two EPs independently. She signed to Capitol Records in 2023, under which her third EP Ache in My Tooth (2024) and debut studio album Mini Skirt Warrior (2026) were released.
